en-US.subtitle: Exam prep in 10 minutes a day
en-US.promotionalText: Ready on exam day. Add your notes, get questions you can check, answer in your own words and see how ready you are for every exam.
en-US.description:
Capling is the study coach for exam day. Spend 10 to 15 minutes a day and know where you stand.

Add what your class gave you. Capling turns it into questions you can check, brings them back just before you would forget them, and shows how ready you are for each exam.

BRING IN YOUR CLASS
• Scan pages, import a PDF (slides too, saved as PDF) or paste text
• Snap the syllabus or a past paper. Cap reads the date, the topics and the format, and you check them
• Record a lecture. It is transcribed on your iPhone, and the moments that matter ("this will be on the midterm", or your own tap) are marked. Tap a time to hear it again
• Bring your Quizlet and Anki sets, or a CSV

QUESTIONS YOU CAN CHECK
• Questions from your notes link back to the page, and Cap circles the lines. Anything else is marked
• New questions arrive as drafts: you approve, edit or skip
• Flashcards, multiple choice, fill in the blank and label the diagram

ANSWER IN YOUR OWN WORDS
• Capling highlights the key ideas you covered and tells you what is missing
• Study out loud on the bus or at the gym: Cap asks, you answer, even with the screen off. Your voice isn't recorded
• Teach Cap a topic and see what you left out

KNOW WHERE YOU STAND
• Readiness for every exam and every topic
• Mock exams like the real one, with no marks until the end
• A plan that bends when your week does, and an exam-eve session: weak spots, then sleep

CAP NOTICES
• Questions about to fade before an exam, two ideas you keep mixing up, a topic with no notes, a date your lecturer mentioned
• One card at a time, three a day at most

ASK CAP
• Ask about your own notes and get answers that point to the page they came from
• Stuck on a problem? Snap it. Cap starts with hints and works through the method from your notes
• Ask Cap to draft questions, a quiz, a note or an exam date. Nothing is added without your yes, unless you turn on "Let Cap do it"
• Cloud AI is optional and off until you turn it on. Without it, questions and grading run on your iPhone, more simply

A HABIT THAT IS KIND
• Your memory sky: every question is a star that dims as you start to forget it and lights up when you review it
• Streaks with freezes, small daily quests, badges and sky themes to unlock. No hearts, and your best streak is kept. Quiet mode hides it all
• Widgets, an exam-week Live Activity and gentle reminders

FREE TO START
Always free: reviews and flashcards, as many as you like; a plan and readiness for every exam; mock exams; your streak, quests and the sky; Quizlet and Anki imports. Each week, 3 AI scans and AI notes for 1 lecture; each day, 20 graded answers and 10 questions for Cap.

Capling Pro lifts the AI limits: AI scans, PDFs and lecture notes with no weekly limit, every answer graded by Cloud AI, Cap's answers and drafts with no daily limit, and web research from trusted sites. Fair use applies. Choose a yearly plan with a free trial, a monthly plan, or Squad, which shares Pro with up to three friends. An Exam Pass gives you 30 days of Pro, one time, with nothing to cancel.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
en-US.reviewNotes: Capling needs no account. Open the app and finish the welcome: it builds a first study set from a sample page, so there is nothing to scan or type. The camera, microphone and speech recognition are asked for only when someone scans a page or records a lecture, and a lecture is transcribed on the device. Cloud AI (Ask Cap) is optional, off until it is turned on in Settings. Sign in with Apple or an email code is only for syncing between devices and for Squad. Capling Pro and the Exam Pass are in-app purchases; "Continue free" is always on the paywall.
